Specification of Communication Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_CM_00204]. If the class is
DdsServiceInterfaceDeployment
, then the
DDS network binding shall handle the mapping of the
StopOfferService()
as de-
scribed in [SWS_CM_11005]. If the class is
UserDefinedServiceInterfaceDe-
ployment
, the Communication Management implementer is responsible for imple-
menting the
StopOfferService()
method in an appropriate way.
⌋
[SWS_CM_00811] Behavior of
ara::com
when calling
StopOfferService
⌈
After
calling
StopOfferService()
, the
ara::com
in the Skeleton side shall consider this
Service as not offered anymore and therefore requests from any proxy shall be ig-
nored.
⌋
[SWS_CM_00814] Callback handling after
StopOfferService
⌈
No callback shall
be invoked after the call to
StopOfferService()
has completed, if a callback is
executed when
StopOfferService()
is called,
StopOfferService()
shall block
until the callback has finished.
⌋
[SWS_CM_00815] Repeated calls to
StopOfferService
⌈
StopOfferService
()
shall ignore repeated calls, as long as
OfferService()
is not called in between.

[SWS_CM_10410]
ara::com::InstanceIdentifier
check during the creation
of service skeleton
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00101
⌈
The Communication Management shall check the value of the
ara::com::Instan-
ceIdentifier
argument: the identifier shall be unique. If the same
ara::com::
InstanceIdentifier
is used for the creation of more than one skeleton instance of
the same service shall be handled as violation according to [SWS_CORE_00090].
